nodes.name: Add Box Collider

nodes.name: Add Capsule Collider

nodes.name: Project Positions
nodes.description: Casts a ray from each element's position attribute in the given direction and writes the hit point back into the position attribute. Useful for snapping elements to terrain or geometry. When no hit is found, the element position is either kept as-is or zeroed depending on 'keepOnMiss'. An optional start offset moves the ray origin along the *opposite* of the cast direction so that elements sitting on a surface are not immediately clipped by it.

inputs.name: Elements
inputs.description: Input ElementSet — must have a 'position' attribute

inputs.name: Direction
inputs.description: Projection direction — normalised automatically (e.g. (0,-1,0) to project downward)

inputs.name: Start Offset
inputs.description: Distance to pull the ray origin back along the opposite of Direction before casting. Use a positive value to ensure elements resting on a surface still get a hit.

inputs.name: Max Distance
inputs.description: Maximum ray travel distance.

inputs.name: Keep On Miss
inputs.description: When true, elements that produce no hit keep their original position. When false, their position is set to zero.

output.name: Elements
output.description: ElementSet with projected positions

nodes.name: Set Material Color
nodes.description: Overrides a drawn element's material color after Draw Instanced or Draw Instanced Indirect. Empty property selects the shader's main color. Source assets remain unchanged.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: color
inputs.description: A color constant or a named Unity color attribute.

inputs.name: propertyName
inputs.description: Shader property reference name, such as _BaseColor or _Color. Empty selects main color.

nodes.name: Set Material Float
nodes.description: Overrides a shader float property (such as smoothness or metallic) per drawn element. Does not change shader keywords or render state.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value constant or named float attribute.

nodes.name: Set Material Texture
nodes.description: Overrides a drawn element's texture after a draw node. Empty property selects the shader's main texture. Read/Write is not required. Shader keywords must already be enabled on the material.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: texture
inputs.description: Texture asset constant or named texture-reference attribute.

inputs.name: propertyName
inputs.description: Shader property reference name, such as _BaseMap or _MainTex. Empty selects main texture.

nodes.name: Set Material Texture Transform
nodes.description: Overrides a texture's tiling and offset per drawn element. Empty property selects the main texture; the shader must use its _ST transform.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: UV offset constant or Vector2 attribute.

nodes.name: Divide Floats
nodes.description: Divides A by B. A zero divisor reports an error.

nodes.name: Assign Mesh
nodes.description: Assigns an asset mesh or a selected mesh from a realized source ElementSet to target points. Mesh references are shared; target transforms and attributes are preserved.

inputs.name: source
inputs.description: Realized mesh bank. Must contain mesh; sourceRow attributes are read on target elements, not on this source.

inputs.name: sourceRow
inputs.description: Zero-based row in source. Attribute bindings are evaluated per target row on elements. Source must be realized first.

nodes.name: Bevel Mesh
nodes.description: Bevels editable mesh groups before Realize Meshes. Each group must be a closed convex solid with matching edge positions. Concave, hollow and disconnected solids are unsupported; a revolved shell is not a safe input. Bevel separate convex prototypes before repetition. Large widths can remove the whole solid.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Bevel width in local mesh units; start small relative to the shortest edge.

inputs.name: minimumAngle
inputs.description: Minimum angle between adjacent face normals, in degrees; coplanar edges are ignored.

nodes.name: Boolean Meshes
nodes.description: Pairs mesh groups by order or broadcasts a single B group. Inputs must use a common coordinate space.

nodes.name: Box Mesh
nodes.description: Creates a centered box definition for each input placement. Dimensions are full lengths in local units and must be positive; nonpositive dimensions emit no geometry. Null input creates one origin prototype; explicit empty input creates none. Realize then Draw Instanced to render.

nodes.name: Combine Mesh Definitions
nodes.description: Combines all mesh groups into one definition. Does not allocate a Unity Mesh or perform a boolean union.

nodes.name: Convex Hull Mesh
nodes.description:
Method: ConvexHull(ElementSet points, MeshNormalMode mode, Single tolerance)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Cylinder Mesh
nodes.description: Creates a capped Y-axis cylinder centered on each input placement, from -height/2 to +height/2. Positive radius/height; segment count is clamped to 3–4096. Output is editable topology, not rendered instances. Null input creates one prototype; explicit empty input creates none.

nodes.name: Explode Meshes
nodes.description: Reads consolidated Unity meshes into editable logical point rows with attached topology. Meshes must have Read/Write enabled.

nodes.name: Follow Spline Mesh
nodes.description: Deforms mesh definitions along an open spline. Source X maps to arc distance; Y/Z become normal/side offsets. Generate or explode meshes first. Existing topology is retained; subdivide long faces before bending. A Y-axis primitive must be rotated onto X before bending. sourceStart/sourceLength map the source X interval onto the complete spline.

nodes.name: Calculate Mesh Normals
nodes.description: Sets shading mode for editable topology, applied when realized. Flat preserves hard faces; SmoothByPointId shares normals by logical point identity. This does not weld positions or repair cracks caused by inconsistent corner displacement.

nodes.name: Place Mesh On Points
nodes.description: Copies one mesh definition onto target points, retaining editable topology. Combine source meshes first; realize only after editing.

nodes.name: Plane Mesh
nodes.description:
Method: Plane(ElementSet elements, FloatValueOrAttribute width, FloatValueOrAttribute depth, IntValueOrAttribute columns, IntValueOrAttribute rows)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Discard Mesh Topology
nodes.description: Keeps all point rows and attributes but discards faces and mesh grouping. Not required for ordinary point edits or spawning.

nodes.name: Realize Meshes
nodes.description: Consolidates each point-based mesh definition into one mesh-bearing placement. Ordinary rows pass through. Identical meshes share resources. Row count changes from point/corner rows to placements; source-row indexes used by Assign Mesh refer to this realized output. Realization alone does not draw anything.

nodes.name: Revolve Profile Mesh
nodes.description: Revolves a radius multiplier curve around Y. Height is measured in metres; start/end select normalized profile heights. Wall thickness stays in metres. Partial sweeps have closed sides. Output starts at local Y=0. Every sampled curve value times radius must exceed wallThickness; thin tips need thinner walls. The result is a hollow shell, generally unsuitable for convex-only Bevel Mesh.

inputs.name: profile
inputs.description: At least two curve keys; time is normalized height and value multiplies radius. All sampled radii must exceed wallThickness.

inputs.name: radius
inputs.description: Radius multiplier in metres; multiplied by the profile value.

inputs.name: wallThickness
inputs.description: Positive radial thickness in metres, strictly smaller than every sampled radius.

inputs.name: sweepDegrees
inputs.description: Positive sweep angle in degrees; capped at 360. Partial sweeps close both cut sides.

nodes.name: Sample Mesh Surface Grid
nodes.description:
Method: SampleGrid(ElementSet elements, FloatValueOrAttribute spacing, Boolean includeEdges, Vector3 projectionNormal, Vector3 gridAnchor)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Sample Mesh Surface
nodes.description:
Method: SampleSurface(ElementSet elements, IntValueOrAttribute samplesPerTriangle, Int32 seed)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: UV Sphere Mesh
nodes.description:
Method: Sphere(ElementSet elements, FloatValueOrAttribute radius, IntValueOrAttribute segments, IntValueOrAttribute rings)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Calculate Mesh Tangents
nodes.description:
Method: Tangents(ElementSet elements)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Transform Mesh
nodes.description: Transforms editable mesh geometry in each mesh group's local space. Translation uses metres, rotation Euler degrees, scale is uniform and non-zero. Generate or Explode meshes first; use ordinary Translate/Rotate/Scale for realized instance placements.

nodes.name: Triangulate Points
nodes.description:
Method: Triangulate(ElementSet points)
Returns: ElementSet

nodes.name: Spline Division Points
nodes.description: Creates division boundary points (N+1) or center points (N) at equal arc distances on an open spline. Local +Z follows the tangent and +Y the normal.

nodes.name: Displace By Texture
nodes.description: Offsets positions by a sampled channel minus midlevel, times strength, along a normalized direction. Zero direction means local up. Operates on points before realization, or on instance positions after realization.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: texture
inputs.description: Texture asset constant or named texture-reference attribute.

inputs.name: uv
inputs.description: Normalized UV constant or Vector2 attribute, such as uv0.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Displacement direction constant or Vector3 attribute; zero uses local up.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the sampled height.

inputs.name: midlevel
inputs.description: Sample value that produces zero height or displacement.

nodes.name: Project UV From Position
nodes.description: Projects position (or another Vector3 binding) onto XZ, XY or YZ. UV = projected position * scale + offset; one unit maps to one repeat by default.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: position
inputs.description: Position constant or Vector3 attribute; select position for spatial projection.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: UV offset constant or Vector2 attribute.

inputs.name: resultAttributeName
inputs.description: Name of the Vector2 UV attribute to create or overwrite.

nodes.name: Sample Texture
nodes.description: Samples a readable Texture2D at normalized UV coordinates. Raw channel values by default; enable decodeSRGB for color maps stored as sRGB.

output.name: Color
output.description: Sampled RGBA, including alpha.

nodes.name: Sample Texture Attribute
nodes.description: Samples a readable Texture2D per element using UV and texture constants or attributes. Writes a color attribute. decodeSRGB explicitly converts RGB before filtering.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: texture
inputs.description: Texture asset constant or named texture-reference attribute.

inputs.name: uv
inputs.description: Normalized UV constant or Vector2 attribute, such as uv0.

inputs.name: resultAttributeName
inputs.description: Name of the Unity color attribute to create or overwrite; tint is recommended.

nodes.name: Sample Texture Height
nodes.description: Samples a channel per element and writes (sample - midlevel) * strength as a float attribute. Height/data maps should use raw values with sRGB disabled on import.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: texture
inputs.description: Texture asset constant or named texture-reference attribute.

inputs.name: uv
inputs.description: Normalized UV constant or Vector2 attribute, such as uv0.

inputs.name: strength
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the sampled height.

inputs.name: midlevel
inputs.description: Sample value that produces zero height or displacement.

inputs.name: resultAttributeName
inputs.description: Name of the float attribute to create or overwrite.

nodes.name: Set Texture Attribute
nodes.description: Writes a texture reference constant or copies a texture attribute. Does not copy pixel data.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: texture
inputs.description: Texture asset constant or named texture-reference attribute.

nodes.name: Texture Size
nodes.description: Returns width and height in pixels.

nodes.name: Transform UV
nodes.description: Scales UV, rotates around the origin in degrees, then adds offset. Inputs can vary per element.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: uv
inputs.description: Normalized UV constant or Vector2 attribute, such as uv0.

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: UV offset constant or Vector2 attribute.

inputs.name: resultAttributeName
inputs.description: Name of the Vector2 UV attribute to create or overwrite.

nodes.name: Create UV
nodes.description: Builds a normalized UV coordinate from U and V.

nodes.name: Create UV Attribute
nodes.description: Builds a Vector2 attribute from U and V constants or float attributes.

inputs.name: elements
inputs.description: Elements to process; results are written to attributes on these elements.

inputs.name: resultAttributeName
